top_signals.title: December Fed-Hike Priced In: JPMorgan’s Kelsey Berro
top_signals.summary:
Kelsey Berro, fixed income portfolio manager JPMorgan Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu on “Bloomberg Real Yield.” The US bond market tumbled for a second straight session as traders brace for the Federal Reserve to step up the pace of its interest-rate hikes in an effort to pull down inflation.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Argentina’s Inflation Ticked Up More Than Expected in October
top_signals.summary: Argentina’s inflation ticked up slightly in October on the heels of September’s pick-up, pointing to sticky price pressures that pose a challenge for President Javier Milei ahead of next year’s election.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Fed Drops October 2027 FOMC Rate Meeting
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg’s Read Pickert joins Scarlet Fu on “Bloomberg Real Yield.” The Federal Reserve dropped a rate-setting meeting scheduled for October 2027 from the Federal Open Market Committee’s calendar, after announcing it would hold one fewer such gatherings next year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
top_signals.summary: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: NYC Sees Nearly $1 Billion Tax-Revenue Jump on Wall Street Gains
top_signals.summary: New York City expects to bring in nearly $1 billion more in taxes than it projected earlier this year, as the government’s coffers are fattened by Wall Street’s technology-driven gains.

top_signals.summary: A COP31 pledge to expand electric power ought to have a green target attached

top_signals.title: United to block customers from using AI agents, citing cyber threats
top_signals.summary: “Sharing account credentials with personal, third-party, AI assistants can expose sensitive information, and actions taken by these tools may result in unintended purchases" and more, United Airlines said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indonesian vice president, son of former leader, steps down over diploma scandal
top_signals.summary: The son of former President Joko Widodo had filed a certificate saying his overseas education was equivalent to a vocational high school in Indonesia.
